name: Absolute Adoration
source:
The wind cut through your jacket and numbed your nose. You- a tired college student- had woken up early this morning to head to class. Teeth brushed, jacket on, and books in bag, you go to the stop and wait for your bus.

…Except it still hasn’t arrived.

Out of the corner of your eye, you notice a boy waiting for the bus as well. He shyly introduces himself as Rai.

Who will Rai be to you and what will come from knowing him?

[From [url=https://wanderingthoughts.itch.io/absolute-adoration]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
风穿过你的夹克，让你的鼻子麻木。你——一个疲惫的大学生——今天早上很早就起床去上课。刷完牙，穿上外套，书包里装上书，你去车站等公共汽车。

……只不过还没到。

你用眼角的余光注意到一个男孩也在等公共汽车。他害羞地介绍自己叫Rai。

Rai对你来说是谁？认识他会带来什么？
